reference: Original benchmark reference, not captions or added clinical labels
correct: Full requested finding/relation is supported; equivalent terms allowed, contradictory or unsupported specificity is not silently accepted
incorrect: Wrong target, wrong finding or reference relation contradicted; frozen prior semantic verdicts retained for exactly identical question/reference/full answer text
uncertain: Incomplete/ambiguous reference equivalence or insufficient supplied evidence
abstain: Explicit refusal or no substantive answer
reuse: Existing V22 frozen blinded semantic labels only; never claim historical model replay or input-token equality from label reuse
new_scoring: Deduplicate exact question/reference/answer, shuffle fixed seed610022, hide arm/owner mapping; freeze every verdict before unblinding
truncation: Record all EOS/caps; incomplete capped answers cannot be treated as complete without evidence
damage: Only Base CORRECT consumers are damage denominator; zero denominator NA
source_echo: Only two original consumers with reference-supported incompatible anatomical target, one unique input; INCORRECT plus exact normalized full source answer is conservative echo count, other relations UNKNOWN
